name: Conventions: render seeded candidates, accept two, merge into a skill
description: From the seeded payments-api repo, open Conventions via the sidebar nav (repo-scoped route, so the id must be resolved through the active-repo context rather than hardcoded), confirm the 4 seeded candidates render, accept two of them, open the Create skill modal, confirm the merged draft, save, and land on the new skill's detail page. Read-only seeded data (no model call) — see server/src/db/seed-conventions.ts. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo, per e2e-web.yml.
